interruption before the seal discards the temporaries so a retry starts from the same pristine inputs, interruption after the seal rolls forward deterministically from the journal, and a journal whose shadow was consumed after the extractor restored inputs is discarded so the hook reruns over pristine data -- a partially transformed stage can no longer be adopted; transactional hooks run unbuffered (PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1) and a hook failure carries the last sanitized detail line (no absolute paths, no owner container names) into the summary; hooks without the member behave byte-identically to before, and the screen, the separately pinned immutable 1.2.16 UI, the terminal-result schema and the NXE#### format are unchanged; 1.2.18 routes every terminal error sink (the setup-screen failure text and the TERMINAL ERROR log line) through the same redaction filter as the terminal JSON, so a raw exception can no longer leak a host path or the owner's container filename into the log a player publishes, and the no-container message now names the gamedata/ folder and the accepted extensions; 1.2.19 centralizes APK-COMPAT-01 in the byte-identical apkcompat contract; 1.2.20 enforces core/optional/ABI-variant members over base+splits, authenticates patch selectors by internal SHA-256 with a common fallback, binds the decision to plan fingerprint/hook env/marker, and closes source_validate, external filename and signing-certificate bypasses while preserving UI/runner/runtime-env bytes; 1.2.21 keeps the metadata fast path, authenticates metadata-only drift through a stable path/type/size/content seal, requires an independent expected content seal before migrating a metadata-drifted 1.2.20 marker, and adds reuse-only validation that refuses pending recovery, UI startup, source discovery and extraction; 1.3.0 closes V3-HARDENING-01 by making the recipe hook resource fence FAIL CLOSED: a CPU, address-space, file-size or process limit that cannot be established now refuses the hook instead of silently running it with no ceiling at all, and the runner and runtime-env bytes are unchanged

v4_controls_03.compatibility: C1-C8 are additive and default-off: the sealed PortMaster corpus, sanitized observed-only receipts, sovereign six-step mapping authority, controller-profile bundle closure, NEXTOSCONTROLLERS v2 null/native closure, Godot and SDL admission seams, strict Android sinks and separate Unity fixture contracts do not migrate an existing port without an explicit opt-in; arbitrary native-engine and Unity physical adoption remain per-port evidence boundaries, and V4 remains open

nxport.generation_nxextract_policy: mode yes/auto requires exactly extractor.json 0644, nxextract/nxextract.py 0644, nxextract/run-extractor.sh 0644, nxextract/nxextract-runtime-env.sh 0644 and nxextract/nxextract-ui 0755 plus every helper/spec as an explicit member below nxextract; a helper-only DSO remains private-library 0644 and is admitted below nxextract only as a strict descendant of a declared private_library_paths root; mode no forbids all NXExtract generation roles and every private-library below nxextract; no game-specific helper/spec name, suffix or member ceiling exists
nxport.legacy_policy: the generator continues to accept schema v1/v2 without generation_runtime and preserves their legacy control-only generation behavior; schema v3 is explicit opt-in and required for public generation-v2 release

home_policy.port: sets HOME to the contained port directory only after explicit opt-in
home_policy.save_and_cache: remain engine-native unless the adapter has a separately proven contained mapping; the generic manifest never redirects them by firmware name

nxport.argument_policy: arrays are passed through shell positional parameters without eval or string concatenation
nxport.prepare_policy: one optional regular non-symlink script contained by the port and executed in foreground
nxport.private_library_policy: only strict descendants of declared contained paths enter a runtime phase; an NXExtract-private DSO is 0644, active-extractor-only and remains role private-library; firmware and PortMaster paths remain separate
nxport.execution_roles_policy: optional schema-v2 opt-in declares extractor, splash, game and helper ABI/executable/executor/interpreter/closure independently; nxgenerator selects NXExtract UI by extractor ABI and NXSplash by splash ABI, while architecture remains the game and PortMaster ABI; absence preserves legacy single-architecture generation

generator.1: invalid manifest, template or filesystem operation

runtime.1: bootstrap/setup failure unless a more specific child status applies
runtime.129: HUP received and exact-child cleanup completed
runtime.130: INT received and exact-child cleanup completed
runtime.143: TERM received and exact-child cleanup completed
runtime.child: all other direct-child exit statuses are preserved

exit_codes.message_policy: diagnosis has four ordered boundaries: missing nxdeployment.json means the observed tree lacks the deployment; a receipt with no new launcher-error or debug.log means there is no durable proof that the early trap was reached, so PortMaster entry/root, interpreter/parse, writable storage, SIGKILL and power loss must be checked without claiming non-invocation; launcher-error means pre-runtime failure after the trap; debug.log phase markers mean nxbootstrap runtime; no script can log before it is executed; secrets, IP addresses and personal paths are excluded from public UI
